changes: Opening the sample pool no longer stops Grain: the track keeps playing its grains while you browse.
FUNC+YES in the pool still previews the sample as plain Flex, until the track's next trig.
Grain can be picked on busier Parts once your base reads the CPU it really adds (a base update).
Play Flex samples and live recorder buffers as a cloud of up to six grains per track.
Set POS and SPRY across the full sample, including long recordings, and see the position on the waveform.
Keep SRC and SETUP values in their own slots during playback and restore Flex controls once when leaving Grain.
Use less CPU preparing and mixing all six stereo grains, including when sliding POS. Grain picks up a new take in the same recorder slot. Each Grain track reserves 35 CPU points.
SCAN reaches exactly double speed at either end and wraps immediately when switching to a shorter sample.
